name: Restart Destiny client
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
podman restart upload-assistant-wastaken || podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 15
echo status:
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'
echo health:
code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/ua-health -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12345/api/health || true)
echo "health_http=$code"
echo logs:
podman logs --tail 30 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 || true
REMOTE
description: Restart the Destiny Upload Assistant service and verify its WebUI and recent logs.
